contexts.text: The book of the nativities () = an enumeration of those who were of the Most Ancient Church.

All the books of the ancients were written (by representatives). Such is the book of Job; Solomon's Song is an imitation of them; such were the two books mentioned in . AC 1756:2. AC 2588:6. AC 2686. AC 2762:2. AC 3179:end. AC 3482. AC 3942:2. DSS 20.
Books not thus written were accounted as valueless, those within the Church as without holiness... Hence the books of the Word were thus written.
The books of that time were almost all written by means of significatives.
That the knowledge of representatives was their wisdom is evident from the oldest books of the Gentiles. AC 4966. AC 5223. AC 9293:3. AC 9407:4.
The book of the covenant () = the Divine truth which they then had.
The little book () = truth Divine.
The book of the law () = the books of Moses... The Law of Jehovah () = the books of Moses, for the prophetical books and the historical ones, except the books of Joshua and Judges did not yet exist.
(Spirits read man's memory like a book.)
Their houses are lined inside with bark...
To write in a book () = for perpetual remembrance. Illustrated.
The laws of order in the other life are not learned from books... but are written on hearts...
That Jeremiah bound a stone to the book written by himself () = that the prophetic Word was perishing through the like things.
Man has as it were two books in which are written all his thoughts and acts; these books are his two memories. (See Memory.)
He took the book of the covenant () = the Word in the letter, with which the Word in Heaven is conjoined. Book = the Word in the whole complex. Explained.
The books of the Word are all those which have an inward sense. Enumerated. NJHD 266.

Blot me out of thy book which Thou hast written () = that the internal of the Word, of the Church, and of worship will not perish... Book = what is in the internal... That the book which Jehovah has written, called elsewhere the book of life = what is internal. Explained.
The Angels can recite in a few words the contents of any book.
a. 3. Their very memorandum books... were opened and read before them, page by page.
I have seen books with writings in them as in the world which were taken from the memory of their authors, not a word being wanting...
Write books... in favour of human prudence and nature, and put them into the hand of any Angel...
A book written within and on the back () = the Word in every particular and every general.

As the Word is meant by a book... it is said to be written in the book, to be judged out of the book, to be blotted out of the book, where the state of the eternal life of anyone is treated of. Illustrated.

To open the book and loose its seals () = to know the states of life of all in the Heavens and on earth, and also to judge everyone according to his state, for when the book is opened, an examination of their character takes place, and then the sentence is pronounced; as a judge does with and from a book of law. AR 295.

Heaven departed as a book rolled up () = separation from Heaven and conjunction with Hell... A book rolled up means a parchment rolled up, for their books were parchments, and comparison is made with a book, because the book = the Word. AE 299:3. AE 404:end.
He had in His hand a little book open () = the Word as to the doctrine therein that the Lord is the God of Heaven and earth, and that His Human is Divine. Explained. AR 472.
To take the little book () = to receive the doctrine concerning the Lord.

The books were opened, and another book was opened which is that of life () = that the interiors of the minds of them all were thrown open... The books = the interiors of the mind of those who are evil, and are judged to death, and the book of life those who are good and are judged to life. They are called books because on the interiors of the mind of everyone are inscribed all things which each has thought, intended, spoken, and done in the world from the will and thence the understanding.
(A book seen there which was the Divine Love and Wisdom.)
The prophecy of this book = the doctrine of this book now opened by the Lord.
Books in the Spiritual World. CL 380:3. SE 4711. SE 5561. SE 5602.
(False lights seen, like open books; some flew upwards and perished; others fell and turned to dust.)
This state (of the Germans is represented in the Spiritual World by a man who carries books under his arms, and who reads the answer to every question out of one of the books.)
(On the lot of bookworms.)
(On the study of books there.)
A book written within and on the back = the state of life of all in Heaven and earth, in general and particular. AE 303.

A book = all things which are with a man, Spirit, and Angel, or all their states of life as to love and faith; wherefore to open the book = to know these things; to read the book = to know them; and to look into the book = to investigate them.
As a book rolled up = that it was closed.
The book of the prophet () = the Word which was in the book, in general, the whole Word.
The Mohammedans have a book in which are some pages written by correspondences.
The Africans have had a book since ancient times which is written by correspondences. SE 5809:end.
Heaps of half open books seen.
The tables and half open books were representatives of the intentions of the mind and thence of the deeds according to which they will be judged faithful and unfaithful.
